description.zh:
待设置的安全组ID。最多可传入10个，安全组ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 将覆盖原设置，取值参考查询您创建的安全组的基本信息[DescribeSecurityGroups](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups)。
description.en: The ID of the security group that you want to manage. You can specify up to 10 security groups. Separate multiple security group IDs with commas (,).

title.zh: 设置实例白名单中的安全组

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口会覆盖实例白名单中原有的安全组，并将**SecurityGroupId**参数中指定的安全组加入至白名单。该API对应的控制台操作请参见[添加安全组](~~148267~~)。
descriptions.en: > After you call this operation, the security groups that are added to the whitelists of the Tair instance are deleted, and the security group specified by the **SecurityGroupId** parameter is added to the whitelists. For more information about how to reset security groups in the Tair console, see [Add security groups](~~148267~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-security-group-configuration --db-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --security-group-id sg-bpcfmyiu4ekp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
